caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The chair has a dark brown color with visible grain patterns suggesting a polished wood surface. It features a contoured, slightly curved slat back with six vertical spindles and an arched crest rail at the top. The seat is flat and broad, made to accommodate one person. The armrests are ornately curved, ending in scrolls that connect to turned support posts. The chair stands on four legs, each connected by stretchers for stability, and is fitted with two long, curved rockers at the base, allowing for the rocking motion. The perspective of the drawing shows the chair angled slightly to the right, providing a clear view of its full structure and design elements. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition, and the background remains plain and unembellished.
title: Rocking Chair: Bishop Hill
